task.title: Share inert tool adapter construction
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/637 by centralizing the preparation, compilation, and construction pipeline shared by activation and replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Use one private implementation for selected artifact preparation, component compilation, and limited adapter construction.
Map shared stage failures into the existing activation and replacement error taxonomies with sources intact.
Keep register_all and replace_all as the distinct lifecycle-specific commits.
Preserve empty no-I/O behavior, caller-selected limits, and deferred authorized invocation.

attempts.summary: Verified the duplication identified by the preceding replacement review.
attempts.diagnostic: Activation and replacement repeated the same empty check, preparation, compilation, and ComponentTool construction stages, risking drift when a stage changed.
attempts.patch: Bounded the refactor to one private adapter-batch helper and one private stage-error taxonomy without changing public lifecycle contracts.

attempts.diagnostic: A shared private result can preserve stage identity while each public operation retains its established error type and registry commit.
attempts.patch: Added ToolAdapterBatchError, conversions to activation and replacement errors, and build_tool_adapter_batch used by both operations.

attempts.summary: Reverified behavior after the structural refactor.
attempts.diagnostic: The refactor needed to preserve the existing empty-selection no-I/O path and ensure limits and source chains did not drift.
attempts.patch: Ran the full activation integration suite and workspace quality gate against the single-file implementation change.

outcome.summary: Activation and replacement now share one inert adapter construction pipeline while retaining distinct atomic registry commits and compatible public error boundaries.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-extensions --test activation
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30225399671 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/638

lessons: Shared trust-boundary stages should have one implementation before another lifecycle operation is added.
Private stage errors can remove duplication without widening or breaking public error contracts.
Registry mutation remains easier to reason about when lifecycle-specific commits stay outside the shared builder.
A narrow structural follow-up can resolve review debt without mixing it into the feature that exposed the duplication.
